text:
Anya: Drafting a runbook for la-new1 region bring-up — focused on image pipeline and GitOps failures. Checklist I have in mind: regional artifact mirror, cosign-signed images, Helm/OCI charts mirror, ArgoCD app-of-apps, pre-warm GPU node pools, and a clear rollback/fallback. Any immediate red flags or missing items?

Chris: All sounds good. Avoid cross-region pulls at scale — use a regional pull-through cache or mirror. We've hit GCR rate limits before, so prefer Harbor/Artifact Registry local mirrors. Cosign for signatures + a verification step in the cluster admission.

Maya: Agree on cosign. Also add pre-population of the mirror with the most recent tags and an index manifest for multi-arch images. In la-new1 the provider had aggressive egress throttling last time — pre-seed the mirror to avoid mass pulls.

Raj (DevEx): Also mirror Helm charts/OCI chart artifacts. If charts are blocked ArgoCD app sync will fail and rollouts get stuck. We should publish charts to the regional OCI registry as part of the pipeline.

Anya: Good — I'll add a Helm section. For GitOps: use app-of-apps, kustomize overlays per region, and patch values for nodeSelector/gpu taints and tolerations. Image tag promotion should be a separate pipeline step so we don't accidentally promote unseeded tags.

Chris: Node pools: recommend pre-scaling to 8-12 GPU nodes with the right taints, then let autoscaler stabilize. Also ensure the nodes have an initJob to pre-pull critical images (pre-pull avoids token handshake storms).

Maya: Note on credentials: our mirror sync job runs from central CI with a service account. Make sure that service account has permission to use the target region KMS for cosign signing/verification. Otherwise verification will fail on-cluster.

InfraBot: image-replicator: last sync OK — 3/3 mirrors updated. Logs: s3://infra-artifacts/la-new1/replicator/2026-03-10.log

Anya: Rollback plan idea: if mirror lag >5m or >1% pull failures, revert ArgoCD to previous commit and enable fallback routing to eu1-hosted model variant until mirror is healthy. Add an automated monitor to trigger that.

Chris: Add a cost checkpoint to the runbook — first-week egress + mirror storage estimate. Cross-region replication / one-time bulk fill can be expensive; put an approval gate for >500GB initial transfer.

Maya: Verification steps to include in the runbook: 1) ArgoCD app health OK, 2) reconcile time <2m for infra apps, 3) sample inference p95 <200ms for 512-token requests against regional endpoint, 4) registry pull success rate >99% for 24h.

Raj (DevEx): I'll add a tiny helper script snippet for operators: `./mirror_sync.sh --region la-new1 --tags recent --verify` and a Helm values fragment for `imagePullSecrets`, `cosignKeyRef`, and `registry.mirror: https://mirror.la-new1.internal`.

Anya: I'll open PR to infra/runbooks with a checklist and the scripts. Who wants to own the SRE handoff document and on-call run-through?

Chris: I'll take handoff. Plan: preflight, mirror populate, helm deploy, post-deploy verification, cost telemetry, rollback steps, and a short run-through with SRE on Monday (include anchors/links to each log).

Maya: One more networking item: confirm egress path uses the regional NAT gateway(s) and firewall allows outbound 443 and 5000 for Harbor. Add diagnostic commands in runbook: `curl -v https://mirror.la-new1.internal/v2/<name>/manifests/<tag>` and `crictl pull` tests.

Anya: :thumbsup: thanks all — assigning reviewers once PR is up. Will include a clear owner for the initial 72h incident watch window.
